body:
Source: GitHub issue #767 (release-audit class data-loss, P1-high). Re-verified on main @ bf3d546a: `packages/skill-rot/lib/frontmatter.mjs` — `parseFrontmatter` (around line 31) keeps only lines matching `key: value` (`if (colonIdx === -1) continue;`), silently dropping every line without a colon: YAML sequence items (`  - Read`), folded/literal scalar continuation lines, and comments. `upsertFrontmatter` then rebuilds the whole frontmatter block from that lossy parse (`Object.entries(frontmatter).map(([k, v]) => \`${k}: ${v}\`)`), so `skill-rot --write` on a real SKILL.md — description: >, a multi-line folded scalar, plus an `allowed-tools:` YAML list — deletes the description body and the entire list, replacing them with an empty `description: >` (invalid YAML) and an empty `allowed-tools:`. There is no dry-run, no backup, and the write is `writeFileSync` truncating in place (no temp+rename), so an interrupt mid-write can leave a truncated file.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/skill-rot`: bin/skill-rot.mjs (the CLI: scans skill dirs, calls `checkSkill`/`upsertFrontmatter` per file with `--write`), lib/frontmatter.mjs (`parseFrontmatter(content)` -> `{frontmatter, body, hasFrontmatter}`, `upsertFrontmatter(content, key, value)` -> updated content string), lib/rot-checker.mjs (calls `writeFileSync(skillPath, updated, 'utf8')` when stamping `last-verified`). Tests: `npm test -w packages/skill-rot`, run with `node --test test/*.test.mjs` from the package dir.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. `upsertFrontmatter(content, key, value)` must NOT re-serialize the frontmatter block from a parsed key/value map. Instead, operate on the RAW frontmatter LINES between the two `---` delimiters: if a line matching `^${key}:` (top-level key, not indented — a nested/list key never starts a line at column 0) already exists, replace ONLY that one line with `${key}: ${value}`, leaving every other line (folded scalars, list items, comments, blank lines) byte-identical; if no such top-level key line exists, insert one new line immediately before the closing `---`. Every other byte of the file — including the body after the closing `---` — must be unchanged.
2. `parseFrontmatter` may stay a lossy key/value reader for CALLERS that only need to read simple scalar values (e.g. skill-rot's own claim-extraction), but `upsertFrontmatter` must not route through it for the write path — implement the splice directly against the raw frontmatter line array. Keep `parseFrontmatter`'s existing return shape and behaviour for read-only callers (do not break `checkSkill`).
3. The actual file write must go through a temp-file + rename (write to `${skillPath}.tmp-<random>` in the same directory, then `renameSync` over the original) so an interrupted write never leaves a truncated skill file. Update `lib/rot-checker.mjs`'s write call site accordingly.
4. CRLF input: preserve the file's existing line-ending convention (detect `\r\n` vs `\n` from the original content) rather than normalizing to `\n`.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 A frontmatter block with a folded scalar (`description: >` + 2 continuation lines), a YAML list (`allowed-tools:` + 3 `- item` lines), and a `# comment` line: after `upsertFrontmatter(content, 'last-verified', '2026-08-29')`, every one of those lines is byte-identical in the output, and a `last-verified: 2026-08-29` line is present. verify: `node --test packages/skill-rot/test/frontmatter-preserve.test.mjs`
- AC2 Re-running `upsertFrontmatter` a second time with a NEW value replaces only the existing `last-verified` line (no duplicate key, still preserves the rest). verify: `node --test packages/skill-rot/test/frontmatter-preserve.test.mjs`
- AC3 A file with no `last-verified` key gets exactly one new line inserted before the closing `---`; a file with no frontmatter block at all is handled the same way as today (document current behaviour in a test, do not change it beyond what's needed for AC1-2). verify: `node --test packages/skill-rot/test/frontmatter-preserve.test.mjs`
- AC4 CRLF input round-trips with CRLF line endings preserved. verify: `node --test packages/skill-rot/test/frontmatter-preserve.test.mjs`
- AC5 The real write path (`lib/rot-checker.mjs`) uses temp-file + rename: simulate a write and assert no partial/truncated file exists if the write is interrupted (mock the rename to throw and assert the ORIGINAL file is untouched). verify: `node --test packages/skill-rot/test/frontmatter-preserve.test.mjs`
- AC6 Existing suite green (39/39 today; if any existing test asserted the lossy re-serialize shape, rewrite it and say so in the PR body). verify: `npm test -w packages/skill-rot`
- AC7 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: #765 (symlinked skills silently skipped) and #766 (zero-claim SKILL.md reported OK) — different bugs in the same package; do not fold them in.

PROCESS (ADLC). Work only in your assigned worktree. P3: the rails on this ticket are frozen — if the fix appears to require editing a rail path, STOP and report; never set ADLC_RAILS_BYPASS. P4: TDD — write test/frontmatter-preserve.test.mjs first, run it RED, then implement. P5 before opening the PR: `npm test -w packages/skill-rot`, `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` (exit 0), then the cross-model review loop (see lane instructions) until a round is clean. Do not add gate-manifest entries. Keep the diff to packages/skill-rot/** and this ticket's shard (no README claims to update — the tool's contract is behavioural, not documented as lossy). PR title `fix(skill-rot): ...`, body must contain `Closes #767`.
title: skill-rot: splice last-verified into frontmatter in place instead of re-serializing (preserve folded scalars, lists, comments)
